Funding total confirmed: USD 550M (200 seed + 235 Series A + 115 extension). Series B (~USD 2B, ~USD 8.5B pre-money) reported by Bloomberg 2026-06-03; some trackers date a close to 2026-07-31, not confirmed by the company.
Series A date 2025-09-17 is approximate (announcement month Sept 2025 per Fierce Biotech, 'last month' relative to the Oct 2025 extension).

Greenhouse board token 'lilasciences': 107 live postings incl. a talent-community form; 122 distinct posting IDs captured in Wayback 2025-10-14..2026-09-19, 78 live postings never captured; >=200 postings in 12 months. Function split is keyword-based.
Locations: Cambridge MA (most), San Francisco, some London.
Pre-Oct-2025 job board not found in Wayback (not on boards.greenhouse.io).
Postings 2026Q3 wayback count is low only because Wayback crawled the board less; ATS first_published shows 54 new that quarter.
Other news: joined DOE Genesis Mission; named to CNBC Disruptor 50 2026 (lila.ai/news).
Leadership start dates are first appearance on the team page, not hire dates; backgrounds not researched in the time budget.
